purpose: Increase object-layout coverage for router training while freezing a new untouched router-confirmation split before the scaled router is trained.
split_unit: scene family; base and answer-changing variants remain in the same split

read_local_digit.description: Identify a globally visible color-shape address, then acquire one local panel crop.

read_global_border.description: Recognize that the global border question requires no additional crop.

required_before_training: all generated images have unique SHA256 values
the unchanged renderer and font hashes match the previously audited pilot
the four fixed train-only audit sheets are inspected for renderer regressions
router_confirmation is not read by training, checkpoint selection, threshold selection, or architecture selection
a separate train-only protocol pins the scaled router budget
claim_boundary: This uses the same deterministic synthetic renderer already audited in v1 with a new seed and more scene permutations. It is intended only to test whether the v1 localization failure was coverage-limited. The frozen router-confirmation split remains synthetic and cannot establish natural-image evidence search.
